contract.trigger: A real HTTP request authenticates headers, then waits for the remaining upload while its token grant changes.
contract.behavior: Current commit-boundary checks compare a request-local SHA-256 fingerprint of the admitted token hash, organization, project, permissions, preview and expiry with the current persisted grant. Rotation or narrowing rejects the held request without secret writes or audit effects.
contract.privacy: The fingerprint remains in a private WeakMap and is absent from serialized principals, responses and audit metadata.
contract.compatibility: No public API or schema changes. Browser session behavior is unchanged; persisted release-window delegation retains its separately defined current-authority checks. This does not certify every asynchronous read or distributed provider side effect.
